Thanks all — drafting proposed SOW language below for quick review and inclusion in the renewal paperwork. If this looks good to TrustCenter and Acme, we can add it to the SOW and circulate for signatures.

Proposed clause (to be inserted under "Data & Evidence Export"):
"At contract termination or upon Customer request, Vendor (TrustCenter) will provide a full evidentiary export comprising JSON manifests and original attachments in a timestamped compressed archive (zip). The Vendor will deliver the export to the Customer within five (5) business days of receipt of a valid export request as defined in Appendix A. Expedited delivery (48-hour turnaround) is available for a one-time fee of $750. Vendor will retain customer evidence for thirty-six (36) months by default; extended retention (up to sixty (60) months) is available for an additional fee as specified in the pricing schedule. Any artifacts maintained as external links will be identified in the export manifest; Customer may request snapshots of link-only artifacts in which case Vendor will make reasonable efforts to capture and include static copies where permitted.

Acceptance: Customer acceptance of the export is limited to verification that the archive contains the declared manifests and attachments. Vendor is not responsible for the content validity of customer-uploaded artifacts.

"

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: confirm the clause is acceptable to TrustCenter legal.
- Marissa: add a short appendix (Appendix A) with an "export request" template (what fields we need to trigger the export).
- Kimberly / Mina: confirm Acme procurement is fine with the 5 business day SLA + optional expedited fee.

Alex — if you can confirm the clause and the fee items today, I’ll circulate an SOW v2 for signatures and attach the sample export.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
